- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4445

ethereum/consensus-specs lacks infrastructure for defining new SSZ types for use in new _features. However, if I want to add EIP-7919 as a _feature, I need additional SSZ types.

Are people cool with those SSZ types being added to the base spec, with a `currently unused` remark? Any related tests could simply be skipped. This would essentially follow the same pattern as the random EIP1234_FORK_VERSION keys in the config.yaml which are only relevant for the corresponding _features folder.
Christoph and Bruno from Flashbots would like to present on the [Free Option Problem in ePBS](https://collective.flashbots.net/t/the-free-option-problem-in-epbs/5115).
